profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I have 15 years of professional experience as a software engineer and have written code for telecom, retail, and energy industries. I enjoy using C#, React, JavaScript, and Python, and I can learn new languages easily.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed planning software for offshore wind farms relating to batteries and cable layout for Equinor. Used React, .NET, and Python for creating applications in Microsoft Azure.
positions.insights: Skills: Unit Testing · Microsoft Azure · .NET · JavaScript · Git · React · Python (Programming Language) · C# · REST APIs

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Used Test Driven Development (TDD) and C# to implement new functionality and to fix bugs. Utilized Inversion of Control (IoC) to create modules which added to and overrode base functionality. Integrated retail point of sale (POS) software with restaurant management software. Helped new employees become accustomed to the software and code. Investigated incidents experienced by users to determine if the issues were caused by bugs or user error.
positions.insights: Skills: Unit Testing · .NET Framework · Test Driven Development · Visual Studio · Microsoft SQL Server · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · C#

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Used Test Driven Development (TDD) and C# to implement new functionality and to fix bugs. Utilized Inversion of Control (IoC) to create modules which added to and overrode base functionality. Integrated retail point of sale (POS) software with restaurant management software. Helped new employees become accustomed to the software and code. Investigated incidents experienced by users to determine if the issues were caused by bugs or user error.
positions.insights: Skills: Unit Testing · .NET Framework · TSQL · Test Driven Development · Visual Studio · Microsoft SQL Server · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · SQL · C#

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Helped professor with the labs for the Operating Systems and the Distributed Systems courses.  Converted lab assignments from the previous year to be graded by the automated grading service. Added multiple choice tests and libraries to grade them. Added new sections to the labs. Tutored students in C and Go in the labs.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Go · C (Programming Language) · golang · Go (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developed Windows services to route and translate messages between servers and clients using C#, .NET, and WCF. Wrote an annotation service to allow managers to add notes to recorded phone conversations. Created an alarm service which allowed other services to send error messages to subscribers of the alarm service.
positions.insights: Skills: Visual Studio · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · C#

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developed a gateway simulator for Cisco Systems for use in automated testing. Ported and modified code from a Java prototype to C++ in an Eclipse development environment. Created automated test cases using Java.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Maintained and updated retail POS software using C++ and MFC. Created new functionality based on user input, suggestions from corporation, and own ideas. Fixed over 100 software issues to make software more reliable. Added the ability to issue multiple gift cards simultaneously. Improved the visual appearance of the software using the gdiplus library to create custom buttons and graphs.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Analyst
positions.description: Load tested financial server applications for banks and other clients. Awarded the “Extra Mile Award” for putting forth additional effort to impress clients. Load tested various server applications using LoadRunner and proprietary load testing software thereby guaranteeing satisfactory program execution. Gathered performance statistics on servers using Windows Performance Monitor. Installed, configured, and maintained operating systems (Windows and Linux), databases (SQL Server 2005 and Oracle 10g), and other software (Argo applications, LoadRunner, and WebSphere). Coauthored several performance documents to describe the tests and results to clients. Maintained an inventory of software installed on servers. Discovered load related errors in applications, which enhanced product reliability. Wrote scripts to populate databases with realistic information to ensure accurate tests. Identified inefficient SQL queries to improve application performance.
